# function: signin_oauth2_public_client_remote

Builds the ARN of an `signin` `oauth2-public-client-remote`:

```
arn:${Partition}:signin:${Region}:${Account}:oauth2/public-client/remote
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`).



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
signin_oauth2_public_client_remote(options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->

<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
